generation_fields.verification_status: PROPOSED or VERIFIED; only VERIFIED permits primary metric
generation_fields.source_snapshot: Path+file/content SHA of existing all40/fixed8 immutable admission
generation_fields.selection: Latest complete published TRAIN prefix per goal, frozen before labels/fits/targets; no performance selection
generation_fields.train_dataset_catalog: 40 original TRAIN dataset/sidecar hashes and behavior-stream cost references
generation_fields.validation_dataset_catalog: 8 original VAL behavior references plus derived DPT targets and output hashes
generation_fields.goal_bindings: Exactly8 matching source goals, each linking the same TRAIN teacher to TRAIN and VAL label roles
generation_fields.legacy_reference: Immutable legacy100 generation/VAL DPT dataset hashes and teacher_transfer metric identity
generation_fields.reporting: Never compare NLL across different generation/teacher/label/window identities as the same metric

behavior_stream_fields.source_contract: Original producer path+SHA, history ID, actual case/episode/decision ordering
behavior_stream_fields.terminal_stream_checkpoint: Original behavior-learning-run checkpoint path+SHA; NOT one actor that generated every historical action
behavior_stream_fields.raw_episode_catalog: Immutable complete episode paths+trace SHAs, recorded sac_observation and row order
behavior_stream_fields.raw_preservation: All raw frames, motor actions, primitive rewards, outcomes and boundaries remain verbatim
behavior_stream_fields.cost_ref: Unique original behavior-stream resource-cost ID; include VALbehavior cost once

label_teacher_fields.task_key: Same source goal as the behavior stream
label_teacher_fields.publication: Preselected TRAIN source index/publication/contract paths+SHAs and update clock

pure_actor_params_digest.scope: All actor parameters including pixel encoder/normalization and action head; exclude optimizer, critic, replay, RNG and counters
pure_actor_params_digest.verification: Derive/check on allocated resources; before/after label inference unchanged; do not substitute full-checkpoint SHA for pure-actor SHA

label_teacher_fields.implementation_identity: Exact producer source pin, official DSRL pin, actor/input/noise configuration
label_teacher_fields.inference: Existing deterministic eval_actions on recorded pixel64/proprio8 SAC observations; no VLA inference, SGD, sampling or simulator
label_teacher_fields.full_training_cost_ref: Unique TRAIN teacher-stream cost ID counted once globally, not once per labeled split

derived_label_fields.input_row_identity: Original behavior trace SHA/case/episode/decision ordinal; no reorder/filter/padding
derived_label_fields.parent_dataset: Original VAL DPT dataset+sidecar hashes retained
derived_label_fields.nonlabel_field_hashes: Exact equality to original VAL arrays for every unchanged field
derived_label_fields.teacher_binding_sha256: Hash of the frozen per-goal teacher catalog
derived_label_fields.new_dataset: Fresh path+SHA+sidecar; never overwrite original source publications

semantic_checks: All8 TRAIN/VAL label roles point to the same verified TRAIN full-checkpoint and pure-actor digest pergoal.
Behavior provenance and per-row behavior clock are independent from the fixed label-teacher clock.
Reuse TRAIN DPT targets only when original publication teacher checkpoint equals the preselected TRAIN binding.
Legacy source_actor_checkpoint_sha256 assumptions require an explicit derived-label admission adapter, never silent metadata reinterpretation.
No source collection or fixed500 selection gate depends on this optional label-generation stage.

cost_accounting.rule: Full TRAIN teacher cost and all8 VAL behavior costs retained once; existing48-stream+shared-overhead accounting is not duplicated by teacher reuse.
cost_accounting.authority: Design only; existing combined29.5h/150GB request remains pending and unchanged.

fallback: If no VERIFIED same-teacher corpus exists within the bound, fit fixed500 on the explicit teacher_transfer generation; never silently claim same teacher.
